subject: Acme Health Tech — Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand Acme's throughput (~500 req/s peak) and the low-latency targets for clinical features. As discussed, next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra team to map integration points, evaluate model routing/quantization options, and align on a proof-of-concept scope.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 14, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Mar 15, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Mar 16, 09:00–10:30

Proposed agenda (60–90 min):
1) 5–10 min intros & objectives
2) 20 min your current infra & data flow (ML + infra)
3) 30–40 min Redwood architecture & integration options (model selection, routing, KV cache, auth)
4) 15 min security/compliance checklist and next steps

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join? Please include your ML lead and infra/ops (we find those three roles useful). I’ll loop in our infra lead Marcus Lin and Solutions Engineer Camila Reyes once we lock a time.

I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short infra checklist our team asks for ahead of deep dives — that will help speed the session.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20280310-discovery-notes.pdf, infra-checklist.csv

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive

Hey Marissa — thanks for the write-up and for sending the notes. Wed Mar 15, 14:00–15:30 PST works best for us.

Attendees from Acme: Priya Reddy (ML Lead), Samir Patel (Infra/Platform). We might also have our security PM join for the last 15 minutes — I’ll confirm by EOD.

A couple quick asks so the session is productive:
- Can Marcus and Camila speak to recommended quantization/latency trade-offs for ~2k token context?
- We’d like to see a sample architecture for private deployment (VPC + KMS) and routing for mixed hosted/dedicated traffic.

If you can send a calendar invite I’ll accept and loop in anyone else.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of AI Engineering
Acme Health Tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive

Perfect — locking Wed Mar 15, 14:00–15:30 PST. I’ve created the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-12345

Camila — I’m tagging you to lead the demo/integration section (model selection, routing, KV caching). Marcus — please be prepared to cover deployment topologies (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC) and our KMS/HSM options; Jordan asked specifically about quantization and latency trade-offs for ~2k token contexts.

Jordan/Priya/Samir — if you can drop the following items ahead of the deep dive it’ll help us tailor the session:
- a short diagram of your current inference path (tokens in -> model outputs)
- sample QPS and 95/99 latency targets
- any compliance requirements (HIPAA-related controls)

I’ll attach a short pre-read (5–10 min) and the infra checklist to the invite. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
